unit: paper with dataset/experiment conditions retained in field values

title.description: Title of this paper, not a cited work.

doi.description: DOI of this paper, if present.

publication_year.description: Publication year; distinguish first online year where explicitly reported.

mapping_contribution.description: Draft assessment of whether THIS study generates, validates, refines, only uses an existing item-attribute mapping, or is unrelated. Equivalent KC/skill models count. Do not confuse estimating CDM parameters with estimating a Q-matrix. Not a final eligibility decision.

methods_investigated.description: Names and brief descriptions of this study’s own mapping methods and comparators; distinguish their roles.

method_family.description: Classify mapping methods investigated by this study, not background mentions. Multi-label hybrids allowed. Expert-driven: substantive expert specification/judgment; statistical: psychometric, Bayesian, likelihood, regularization or factorization estimation/testing; machine learning: learned predictive/neural/tree/clustering mapping methods; LLM-based: large language model generates/validates/refines mapping. Explain borderline classifications in value.

domain.description: Empirical application setting: educational measurement (assessment/test diagnosis), ITS/learning analytics (tutoring/logs/KC models), psychological/clinical assessment (symptoms/personality/noncognitive attributes). Multi-label allowed. Pure simulations without an explicit domain use domain_unspecified_simulation; do not assume educational measurement from DINA alone.
codes: intelligent tutoring systems and learning analytics

q_matrix_task.description: Task applied to the item-attribute mapping itself: initial generation, validation, or refinement. Mere use of a fixed mapping is not a task contribution. Multi-label allowed.

data_type.description: Data actually used by this study: simulated and/or empirical. Code both when both occur. A theoretical/no-data paper uses neither.

sample_size.description: Sample sizes per named empirical dataset and simulation condition; distinguish participants from interactions and simulation replications. Preserve ranges/conditions and units.

number_of_items.description: Number of assessment items per dataset/experiment or simulation condition; identify conditions rather than conflating them.

number_of_attributes.description: Number of diagnostic attributes/skills per named dataset or simulation condition.

response_type.description: Observed item-response categories: dichotomous versus polytomous. Distinguish polytomous latent attributes from polytomous item responses. Mention response times separately, not as polytomous responses.

attribute_structure.description: Independent/nonhierarchical, hierarchical/prerequisite, correlated or mixed attribute structures, with details. Attribute correlations are not automatically prerequisite hierarchies.

diagnostic_model.description: Names of diagnostic models used in this study and relation to conditions, e.g. DINA, G-DINA, DINO, LCDM. Not models mentioned only in background.

simulation_misspecification_proportion.description: In simulations, fraction/percentage of Q-matrix entries initially misspecified and how errors were introduced; distinguish entry error rate from fraction of items altered. not_applicable only if the study has no simulations. If simulations exist but this is unspecified, not_reported. Normalize numeric proportions to 0–1 and use unit proportion; keep the original percentage in the narrative.

simulation_item_quality.description: In simulations, item-quality conditions, e.g. slipping/guessing/discrimination parameters and levels. not_applicable only if there are no simulations; otherwise not_reported if missing.

benchmark_datasets.description: Names/sources of benchmark datasets actually used to evaluate the mapping method, linking metrics to datasets. Explicitly unnamed empirical data are not named benchmarks.

q_matrix_recovery.description: Mapping recovery criterion, operational definition, results and condition: entrywise accuracy, exact Q-matrix recovery, item-vector recovery etc. Not latent-attribute classification accuracy.

attribute_classification_accuracy.description: Attribute-profile or attribute-wise classification accuracy, metric, results and conditions; distinguish from mapping recovery.

classification_reliability.description: Reliability/consistency of diagnostic classifications; distinguish from classification accuracy and generic test reliability.

power.description: Power/sensitivity of Q-matrix validation tests, with test, criterion, numerical findings and conditions. Generic predictive accuracy is not power.

type_i_error.description: Type I error/false-positive rate of Q-matrix validation tests, with test, nominal alpha, results and conditions. Not generic misclassification error.

model_fit.description: Fit criteria used to assess the mapping method (likelihood, AIC/BIC, RMSEA, residuals etc), results and conditions. Distinguish evaluation of a fixed CDM from evaluation of mapping changes.

held_out_prediction.description: Prediction of held-out responses: split/CV protocol, metrics and results. Training fit alone is not held-out prediction.

expert_matrix_agreement.description: Agreement with expert-specified mappings: reference construction, agreement metric, results. A simulation true matrix is not an expert reference.

expert_review.description: Expert judgment/review used to evaluate the mapping and its findings, distinct from expert generation.

think_aloud_review.description: Think-aloud/cognitive interview evidence used to evaluate item-skill mappings and findings.

computational_cost.description: Reported runtime, memory, hardware, complexity or resource requirements, with conditions. Algorithm iterations alone are not elapsed time.

author_reported_limitations.description: Limitations explicitly acknowledged by authors of THIS mapping study; preserve each limitation and its method/condition, with short evidence. Do not invent weaknesses or borrow cited studies’ limitations.

limitation_themes.description: Provisional multi-label themes grounded only in author_reported_limitations. Retain emergent themes as other with explanation; not an exhaustive final codebook. Never add a theme without an author statement.
